## 📌 Summary (recommended)
What changed, and why? Keep this short enough for a reviewer to understand the
purpose before reading the diff. Omit if the ticket and verification already
make the change unambiguous.

## 🧪 How to Test (required)
List reproducible commands or manual steps, the result, and any check not run
with its reason.

## 🔗 Jira Ticket (required)
PWDRZ-XXXX

## ⚠️ Notes / Risks (optional)
Optional: migration, compatibility, deployment or security impact; known
limitations; screenshots for visible UI changes.
